EthosEnergy Operations and Maintenance is seeking a Health, Safety and Security Manager to lead health and safety programs, risk management activities, regulatory preparedness, and continuous improvement initiatives across North America. This role partners closely with site operations, and business leaders to strengthen safety performance, support compliance, and promote a proactive culture where employees work safely and operational risks are effectively managed.  

The ideal candidate is an experienced health and safety professional who can translate regulatory requirements, operational data, and field observations into practical programs, clear guidance, and measurable improvements.

* Assess the likelihood and severity of potential incidents, exposures, and loss events.
* Analyze incident reports, safety observations, and performance data to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Recommend surveys, inspections, audits, appraisals, or targeted risk assessments based on operational needs and risk exposure. Program Development and Compliance Support

* Lead or support investigations involving near misses, first aid events, recordable injuries, spills, security incidents, and other EHS events.
* Apply root cause analysis methods and track corrective actions through completion to prevent recurrence. Performance Improvement and Leadership Support
* Evaluate the effectiveness, cost, and performance of hazard control programs, systems, and improvement plans.
* Support management accountability processes and audit programs that assess safety performance across sites and operations.
* Track, measure, and analyze health and safety performance indicators and recommend practical actions for improvement.
* Lead or support special projects and initiatives as assigned. What You Will Bring

jobs.title: Consulting Operations Manager - Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
**Position:** Consulting Operations Manager \| Technical Project Manager

**Location:** United States – Remote, Chicago, IL area preferred (1\-day in office per week)

**Employment Type:** Full Time or Contract\-to\-Hire

**Who this role is for:** You turn signed consulting agreements into well\-scoped, properly staffed, accurately billed engagements. You combine project control, capacity planning, financial rigor, cybersecurity literacy, and client judgment \- and work independently to protect delivery quality, scope, and margin.

**What You'll Do**

* Own cybersecurity consulting engagements from internal handoff through scheduling, delivery, billing, and closeout.
* Translate statements of work into project schedules, consultant assignments, milestones, dependencies, and billing triggers.
* Coordinate capacity across a small billable team, balancing client commitments, consultant skills, utilization, and deadlines.
* Maintain Excel\-based project and financial controls using formulas, structured tables, lookups, WORKDAY, SUMIFS, and related functions.
* Administer milestone billing and contract mechanics, including deliverable\-based invoice dates, payment schedules, scope reductions, credits, and billing reconciliation.
* Lead client communication, resolve delivery or billing disagreements, and maintain a clear, fact\-based position when necessary.
* Identify scope creep, quantify its effect, and convert out\-of\-scope requests into approved change orders before work proceeds.
* Oversee testing, findings, reporting, and retesting workflows; improve operational tools and handoffs while protecting sensitive client and financial information.

**What You Bring**

* Experience managing projects or operations in a professional services, consulting, or other billable environment.
* Advanced Excel capability, including formulas, structured tables, lookups, WORKDAY, SUMIFS, date logic, and reconciliation \- not simply data entry or workbook maintenance.
* Working knowledge of milestone billing, contract mechanics, deliverable\-based invoicing, scope reductions, and change orders.
* Experience coordinating schedules and capacity for a small team of specialized professionals.
* Strong client\-facing written and verbal communication, with the judgment to manage disputes constructively and defend a well\-supported position.
* Cybersecurity literacy covering common offensive or defensive assessment types, findings, evidence, remediation, and severity ratings.
* Demonstrated self\-direction, problem solving, scope discipline, and discretion with sensitive vulnerability, client, pricing, and margin information.

**Strong Pluses**

* Experience with PSA, CRM, or sales\-pipeline platforms such as Autotask, ConnectWise, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or HubSpot.
* Experience with work\-management and Microsoft 365 tools, including Planner, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, SharePoint, Lists, Teams, and Outlook.
* Experience administering PlexTrac or a comparable security reporting platform.

**Nice to Have**

* Subcontractor coordination experience.
* PMP certification or an equivalent project\-management credential.

**Why Join HALOCK**

At HALOCK, consulting operations is not an administrative function. It directly influences delivery quality, consultant effectiveness, billing accuracy, margin, and client trust. You will work with experienced security consultants and business leaders in a high\-trust environment where you are expected to surface risks early, challenge unclear assumptions, and improve how work gets delivered.

**What you can expect:** Remote\-first work, meaningful ownership, varied cybersecurity engagements, experienced teammates, and room to improve the systems behind client delivery.

**About Us**

HALOCK Security Labs is a full\-service information security consulting firm in Schaumburg, Illinois. Since 1996, we have provided technical security expertise and strategic advisement across penetration testing, red teaming, malware defense, incident response, risk, and compliance.

HALOCK offers competitive compensation and benefits, including bonus potential, paid training and certifications, health and dental coverage, 401(k), long\-term disability, conference attendance, and more.

**Ready to apply?** Send your resume and a brief note describing a complex consulting engagement you coordinated, how you controlled scope and billing, and how you handled a difficult client or scheduling issue.

**Disclosures**

* HALOCK is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
* Full background checks are performed, with consent, on all successful candidates before employment offers can be extended.
* US citizens and Green Card holders, EAD and TN are encouraged to apply. **We are unable to sponsor H\-1B candidates at this time**.
* No third parties, please. Only individuals need apply.

Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $125,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

Analytic Acquisitions is seeking an experienced Project Manager to oversee personnel and service delivery for a nationwide Federal contract supporting the National Archives and Records Administration's Federal Records Center Program. (NARA)

The Project Manager will provide program\-level oversight of contractor personnel and operations across multiple Federal Records Center locations. This position will serve as the primary management point for staffing, performance, quality, reporting, personnel issues, operational risks, and communication with Government stakeholders.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience managing the day\-to\-day operations of Federal Government service contracts involving geographically dispersed personnel, multiple work locations, workforce management, quality control, and recurring contract deliverables.

***\*Must be authorized to work in the US and able to pass a Federal Background Check.***

**"This job is a civilian position and does not require military service (including commission and enlistment)."**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee contractor personnel and services delivered across active Federal Records Center locations.
* Maintain regular communication with the Contracting Officer, Contracting Officer's Representative, FRC Directors/Points of Contact, site leadership, and contractor personnel.
* Ensure adequate staffing is maintained at locations where services are required.
* Monitor contract performance, staffing levels, vacancies, employee performance, quality, training, and operational risks.
* Coordinate recruiting, onboarding, personnel changes, and workforce continuity.
* Ensure contractor personnel comply with applicable personnel, security, conduct, and facility requirements.
* Identify performance or personnel issues and coordinate timely corrective action.
* Maintain visibility into site\-level production and quality performance.
* Coordinate with Site Managers, Supervisors, Quality Assurance Leads, and Team Leads.
* Ensure required timekeeping and employee work\-hour information is accurate and submitted as required.
* Support accurate and timely invoicing and contract administration.
* Prepare, review, and submit required monthly performance information.
* Track identified problems, corrective actions, staffing changes, anticipated staffing needs, and emerging operational risks.
* Coordinate Government\-directed changes and resolve issues requiring program\-level attention.
* Support continuity of operations during staffing changes, workload surges, facility interruptions, and authorized overtime requirements.
* Maintain organized contract records and provide management information needed to support Government oversight.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Candidates must meet the following minimum requirements:**

* At least three years of management experience involving the day\-to\-day operations of Government contracts of similar size, scope, and complexity.
* Excellent written communication skills.
* Excellent verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational skills.
* Effective time\-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage personnel, competing priorities, deadlines, and performance requirements.
* Ability to communicate professionally with Government customers and contractor employees.

**Preferred Experience**

**Preference will be given to candidates with experience in one or more of the following:**

* Managing Federal Government service contracts.
* Managing geographically dispersed or multi\-site workforces.
* Federal records, document management, warehouse, logistics, administrative support, or records\-processing operations.
* Recruiting, onboarding, employee retention, and workforce planning.
* Quality\-control or performance\-management programs.
* Corrective\-action and performance\-improvement processes.
* Government contract reporting, timekeeping, invoicing, and deliverable management.
* Managing supervisors, site managers, team leads, or quality personnel.
* Supporting operations with changing staffing levels or workload requirements.

**Core Competencies**

**Successful candidates should demonstrate:**

* Federal contract management
* Multi\-site workforce management
* Customer communication
* Personnel management
* Staffing and workforce planning
* Quality and performance management
* Problem identification and resolution
* Corrective\-action management
* Contract reporting
* Organization and time management
* Leadership and accountability

**Application Requirements \-**

**Applicants should submit a current resume that clearly identifies:**

* Government contracts managed;
* Customer/agency supported;
* Position held;
* Period of performance or dates of employment;
* Size and complexity of the operation;
* Number of personnel and/or locations managed, where applicable;
* Major management responsibilities; and
* Specific experience managing day\-to\-day Federal contract operations.

***Candidates whose resumes do not clearly demonstrate the required Government contract management experience may not be considered.***

**\*Analytic Acquisitions, LLC. is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.**

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract

Pay: $150,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Have you managed geographically dispersed or multi\-site workforces?
* Do you have experience working with the National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) ?

Experience:

* managing government service contracts: 3 years (Required)

Please DO NOT submit any candidates without Investment Management or Asset Management experience. DO NOT submit if the candidate has only BANK working experience. The profiles will be rejected.  

NJ candidates will be given priority compared to candidates from other locations joining on day 1\. We are open for other locations candidates who are willing to relocate but NJ based candidates will be given priority based on our past experience.  

  

  

Descriptions:  

  

We are seeking an experienced Technical Business Systems Analyst to support a global financial services client environment. This role sits at the intersection of business, data, and technology, and plays a key role in enabling data driven decision making, supporting critical platforms, and delivering change across business and technology teams.  

The role is heavily focused on BAU data provisioning with end to end ownership of data onboarding, issue investigation and resolution, and continuous improvement, operating within an Agile delivery model.  

The successful candidate will be hands on, proactive, and accountable, with strong financial services / capital markets domain knowledge, solid SQL skills, and the ability to decompose complex business logic, understand existing technical implementations, and work closely with business stakeholders and engineering teams to ensure the reliable, high quality delivery of data products.  

  

Key Responsibilities:  

* Own end to end delivery and support of financial services data products, from requirement intake through production support, ensuring stability, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Act as the primary Technical BSA for BAU and production data issues, taking accountability for root cause analysis, remediation, and prevention of recurring issues.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate financial domain business needs into clear, actionable functional and technical specifications, including data mappings, transformations, and validation rules.
* Work closely with data engineering and technology teams to analyze existing data logic, review SQL and code, and validate that implementations align with business intent.
* Proactively monitor and assess data quality, identify issues early, and drive resolution through to completion rather than simple escalation.
* Support Agile delivery by contributing to backlog refinement, sprint planning, story breakdown, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Risk, Operations, and downstream consumers to clarify requirements, resolve data questions, and ensure shared understanding of outputs and impacts.
* Ensure data solutions meet production grade standards, including stability, accuracy, traceability, auditability, and operational resilience.
* Continuously improve BAU processes, controls, and documentation, reducing operational risk and improving transparency and efficiency.
* Proactively identify opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and improved data controls, incorporating best practices across financial services data delivery.
